title: NFL game-log refresh: 16-player cap per event and a recency test that re-pulls NFL players every tick
device: n/a (pipeline script /tmp/pnfl/run.ts, copy in tickets/evidence/PNFL-pipeline-run.ts, output PNFL-pipeline-run.log)
steps: Line 59 slices players to 16; NFL props cover far more players per game, in arbitrary snapshot order
Line 61 skips a player only if their newest game_date is < 2 days old, but NFL teams play weekly so that is never true
expected: Logs fetched once per player per day-ish, for all players with props, within budget.
actual: Players beyond the first 16 never get logs (so never a sim); the first 16 are re-fetched (1 request each, 20 games) on every tick, burning the PropLine budget. Guess: the check should use a fetched-at time, not the last game date.
evidence: tickets/evidence/PNFL-pipeline-run.log; UI check: /slate?sport=nfl&view=props shows the correct empty state ("No NFL player props right now") on QA-OPEN
